0|5903123f662ed18483f05cac3f9e800a074c29ff|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"tcp: Use BPF timeout setting for SYN ACK RTO
When setting RTO through BPF program, some SYN ACK packets were unaffected
and continued to use TCP_TIMEOUT_INIT constant. This patch adds timeout
option to struct request_sock. Option is initialized with TCP_TIMEOUT_INIT
and is reassigned through BPF using tcp_timeout_init call. SYN ACK
retransmits now use newly added timeout option.

column2: - Add timeout option to struct request_sock. Do not call
tcp_timeout_init on every syn ack retransmit.
- Use unsigned long for min. Bound tcp_timeout_init to TCP_RTO_MAX.
- Refactor duplicate code by adding reqsk_timeout function.
